title: Ytterbium
description: A new UI based off of OreUI.
body:
###

A simplistic GUI resource pack similar to OreUI!

## Additions This resource pack redesigns the UI of Minecraft to be a sort of dark mode version of the game, and makes it more... square. This mod will be updated for future versions of the game. Currently, the plans are to finish the pack and expand to support for mods.
Mod Plans
  1. Appleskin
  2. Create
  3. Just A Few Pickaxes
  4. That's A Smart Phone
  5. Simple Voice Chat
  6. Jade
  7. JEI (Just Enough Items)
  8. Essential Mod
## Credits Thank you everyone on [TheAxoltolOrg](https://modrinth.com/organization/theaxolotlorg) for fowarding the creation on this project, and thank **_you_** for supporting our little projects! [**_TheAxolotlLord_**](https://modrinth.com/user/TheAxolotlLord) - Lead Developer - Primary Tester - Texture Editor [**_Zirosi_**](https://modrinth.com/user/zirosi) - Secondary Tester - Markdown Editor [**_EddieR5_**](https://modrinth.com/user/EddieR5) - Tertiary Tester ## Reason behind _Ytterbuim_ Currently I working on a collection with all 118 elements on the periodic table. After we worked on [Cerium](https://modrinth.com/datapack/cerium) we decided to make a resource pack next, called Ytterbuim! This is because the number associated with Hatsune Miku is 39, and the 39th Element is Yttrium. This was the closest element that was not taken!
